claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: PG-9 is annotated as an acetylcholine receptor agonist with no listed targets, and the retrieved abstracts are unrelated to its pharmacology (they concern liposome formulations, lipid bilayer biophysics, prostaglandin biology, and bacterial enzymes), so no mechanism of cancer cell killing at 2.5 uM can be inferred and it is expected to be largely inactive.
